messages:
incident-bot: Pager: [sev=high] inferpool-usw: increased 5xxs and node NotReady flaps for nodes with GPU driver OOMs. Pager triggered for oncall.
alice_oncall: I'm on it. jumping in — gathering context.
alice_oncall: @bob_sre can you confirm if this is kernel OOMs or driver crash? saw a few container restarts in logs.
bob_sre: digging. I can see kubelet restarted on gke-infer-34 twice in last 3m. dmesg shows "Out of memory: Killed process" on nvidia driver.
carla_infra: also seeing repeated "NVML: GPU reset" events in node logs.
dave_prod: traffic spike? any client causing huge seq len? :thinking_face:
alice_oncall: no spike in request count, but token lengths increased for a small customer — we'll throttle if needed.
bob_sre: snippets:
```
Sep 12 10:22:01 gke-infer-34 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 23456 (serving-runtime) score 145
Sep 12 10:22:02 gke-infer-34 kubelet[...]: container "runtime" restarted (exit code 137)
Sep 12 10:22:03 gke-infer-34 nvidia-smi: GPU reset occurred
```
alice_oncall: plan: cordon + drain the affected node, re-route traffic, scale up inferpool by +2, and set routing fallback to replica models in eu-west if capacity short.
carla_infra: agree. preparing cordon cmd.
carla_infra: `kubectl cordon gke-infer-34 && kubectl drain gke-infer-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
bob_sre: while draining, create a temporary HPA patch to add 2 replicas to inference-deployment in us-west1:
```
kubectl scale deploy/inference --replicas=24 -n redwood-infer
```
alice_oncall: applied routing policy: `route override: inferpool-usw -> prefer usw-dedicated, fallback eu-west-1`
dave_prod: notified customers via status.redwood.ai/incidents/1813456789 :link:  
alice_oncall: monitoring: backend error rate dropping from 6.2% -> 1.1% after drain + scale. latency steady. :thumbsup:
bob_sre: investigating root cause: hypothesis: driver memory leak triggered by long-lived KV cache + sudden longer sequences. opening bug with kernel logs attached.
carla_infra: temporary mitigation: set kubelet eviction threshold tighter on GPU nodes and reduce per-pod memory limit for runtime.
alice_oncall: will keep this thread updated. assigning follow-ups: @bob_sre root-cause and remediation PR, @carla_infra infra hardening, @dave_prod customer communication.
bob_sre: noted. I'll collect core dumps and upload to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incident-1813456789/cores
alice_oncall: final: nodes stable, no more flaps for 12m, error rate normalized. closing pager. will publish postmortem tomorrow.
dave_prod: thanks team. :heart:
